help.credentialReference: Only an encrypted reference is stored and the original value is never returned. Leave blank to keep the current configuration.
help.credentials: Enter a JSON object. Sportmonks uses the api_token field; a Goalserve shadow source uses the request_url field with the full HTTPS URL from the account portal. Credentials are encrypted and never returned by the API. Leave blank when editing to keep the current configuration.
help.scorePolling: Disabled by default. When enabled with configured credentials in testing or shadow mode, only score raw snapshots and mapping candidates are collected; official data is never published automatically.
